requirements.sourceQuote: You have an undergraduate university degree in computer science or mathematics with a computer science/mathematics component of at least 120 ECTS credits.

If you completed a four-year, non-ECTS degree, the 120 [ECTS](https://www.uni-passau.de/en/msc-ai-eng/#ECTS) credit requirement is deemed to be met if two-thirds of your credit points were earned in computer science/mathematics-related modules/courses.
